#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

typedef long long int LL;

const LL MOD = 1000000007;

LL power(LL base, LL exp) { LL result = 1; for(int i=0; i<exp; ++i) result = (result * base) % MOD; return result; }

LL compute(LL p, LL k)
{
    if(k <= 1) return power(p, p - 1 + k);
    int order = 1;
    for(LL current = k; current != 1; ++order) current = (current * k) % p;
    return power(p, (p - 1) / order);
}

int main() {
    LL p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << compute(p, k) << endl;
    return 0;
}
